title: Ethereum Whales Keep Buying While ETH Tries To Hold Above $1800
subTitle:
Ethereum has been trying to recover but the move higher did not last. A few days ago the price reached around $1944 but sellers quickly pushed it back down. After that ETH dropped close to $1819 before finding a small bounce. Even with that recovery the market is still moving carefully and many traders are waiting to see what happens next.
One part of the market that is getting attention is whale activity. Large holders have been very active during the recent price drop. Reports showed that two new wallets received a total of twenty thousand ETH with a value of about thirty seven million dollars. The transfer happened in two equal parts.
The same whale did not stop there. During the last three days the wallet collected almost eighty nine thousand four hundred ETH with a total value close to one hundred sixty five million dollars. That is a very large amount and it shows that at least one big holder believes this price area is worth buying.
Still it is important to stay realistic. One whale cannot decide the direction of the whole market. Big investors sometimes buy during weak markets because they expect better prices later. At the same time other traders may still be selling. This is why whale activity should be watched together with other market signals.
Another point that supports the buying story is that more Ethereum has been leaving trading platforms than entering them. When coins move away from exchanges some people see it as a sign that investors want to hold instead of sell. During the last two days this trend continued although the speed of those outflows became a little smaller.
Even with this buying interest the market is not fully strong yet. Short term price action still shows that sellers have the upper hand. Every time Ethereum tries to move higher it faces resistance and buyers have not been able to keep control for very long.
The next price area that many people are watching is around eighteen hundred dollars. If Ethereum stays above this level buyers may slowly build confidence again. A stronger recovery could then bring the price back toward the previous resistance near nineteen hundred twenty eight dollars. If that level is broken then the market could start looking at the two thousand dollar area again.
On the other hand if selling pressure becomes stronger and Ethereum falls below eighteen hundred dollars then the next support may appear around seventeen hundred seventy four dollars. That would keep the market under pressure until buyers return in larger numbers.
Right now the market is showing two different stories. Large holders are adding more Ethereum while the overall price is still struggling to recover. This does not guarantee that the market will move higher right away. It simply shows that some experienced investors are willing to buy while prices remain weak. The coming days will show whether that confidence spreads across the wider market or if sellers continue to stay in control.
